svg.text: One lane per core capacity: what is claimed, the question that tests it, the knob turned to ask, what is measured, and the shape of the answer.
the adapter contract is what makes this a benchmark rather than a set of experiments
Lower-triangular matrix, read down columns; three summary
Can a partial or degraded cue regenerate
Completion curve vs. cue fraction and vs. σ
Are episodes that share a subsequence
How much of an episode is acquired
Acquisition curve vs. number of exposures
Can the dynamics be iterated once
Span vs. length; drift trace; position curve
Does a learned structure transfer to a
Transfer curve; gap against the linear control
Is the interval itself encoded, not just
Timing curve; invariance under tempo rescaling
apply to every lane at once; declare with every run
Gates which dimensions are definable at all. Chips marked ✳ exist only here.
Every dimension is manipulated within a modality; modality is orthogonal to all of it.
Ground-truth item feedback — cued vs. free-running
Episode identity — context: veridical / degraded / in-band / absent / conflicting
Episode segmentation — explicit reset / marker / inferable / none
How much of the problem the harness solves outside the model. Four instances of one design decision — two are declared and reported per run, two are not.
Solid chips are implemented in memval/ as of this tree; dashed chips are proposed. Generated by docs/figures/overview_figure.py
